description:
Find French EPR unique identifiers (identifiant unique REP, format FR123456_01ABCD) in the public ADEME register (SYDEREP).
    A producer covered by an EPR scheme (packaging, textiles, furniture, electronics, toys…) must show them in its terms of sale.

    Args:
        query: a SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), an identifier (FR…_…), or a company name (at least 3 characters).
name: lookup_epr_id
